description: This Java source file defines a Cucumber step definitions class 'LoanChargeAdjustmentStepDef' for testing loan charge adjustment features in the Fineract project. It contains methods for performing charge adjustments, reverting them, and validating error responses, relying on external APIs and data models.

classes.name: LoanChargeAdjustmentStepDef
classes.description: A Cucumber step definitions class for testing loan charge adjustments, including making adjustments, undoing them, and validating error responses.

methods.name: makeLoanChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Performs a charge adjustment for the last qualifying charge based on provided charge type and date.

methods.name: loanChargeAdjustmentFailedOnWrongAmount
methods.description: Validates that an error occurs when making a charge adjustment with an amount exceeding the available charge amount.

methods.name: loanChargeAdjustmentUndo
methods.description: Reverts a previously raised charge adjustment using transaction data.

methods.name: checkChargeAdjustmentResponse
methods.description: Checks that the charge adjustment response includes a non-null external ID.

methods.name: getTransactionIdForTransactionMetConditions
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID for a transaction matching specified date and amount conditions.

methods.name: makeChargeAdjustmentCall
methods.description: Executes an API call to perform a charge adjustment.

methods.name: getTransactionIdForLastChargeMetConditions
methods.description: Finds the last charge that matches specified charge type and due date conditions.
